name: Fairphone 4
notes: Install current official Fairphone firmware before postmarketOS. Fairphone fastboot restoration erases personal data.

modes.fastboot: Power off and unplug USB. Hold Power + Volume Down; alternatively hold Volume Down while connecting USB to the computer.
modes.recovery: Power off and unplug USB, then hold Power + Volume Up.

unlock.text: Enable OEM unlocking and unlock the bootloader using Fairphone's instructions. Unlocking erases personal data.
steps: Back up personal data; bootloader unlocking wipes the phone.
Update to current official Fairphone firmware before installing postmarketOS.
Follow Fairphone's bootloader unlock guide and confirm the unlock on the phone.
hints: Nura says critical partitions do not need to be unlocked.

recovery.text: Restore official Fairphone OS using the current factory ZIP and Fairphone's extracted flash_fp4 script. This fastboot restore erases personal data.
